Take an image of a component.desc: This action enables a uav to take an image of a component, but only if it is currently available. After taking the image, the uav becomes unavailable.
Take an image of a component.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to take a picture of [object1] if the uav is [state1]. After taking picture, the uav becomes [state2].

Analyse image of a component that is in.desc: This action enables a uav to analyze an image of a component that is in a bad state. If an image has been taken, the uav can process it and mark the component as an anomaly. After analysis, the uav becomes available again.
Analyse image of a component that is in.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to analyze [object1] of [object2] that is in [state1]. If [object1] has been taken, the uav processes it, marks [object2] as [state2], and becomes [state3].

Analyse image of a good component.desc: This action enables a uav to analyze an image of a component that is not in a bad state. If an image has been taken, the uav can process it and then doesn't need to do anything. After analysis, the uav becomes available again.
Analyse image of a good component.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to analyze [object1] of [object2] that is in [state1] state. If [object1] has been taken, the uav does nothing and becomes [state2].

Measure thermal value of a component.desc: This action enables a uav to measure the thermal value of a component, but only if the uav is currently available. After measuring, the uav becomes unavailable.
Measure thermal value of a component.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to measure [value1] of [object1] if the uav is [state1]. After measuring, the uav becomes [state2].

Analyse thermal value of a good componen.desc: This action enables a uav to analyze the thermal value of a component. If the value is below the maximum threshold, the uav doesn't have to do anything. After analysis, the uav becomes available again.
Analyse thermal value of a good componen.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to analyze [value1] of [object1]. If [value1] is below [value2], the uav does nothing and becomes [state1].

Analyse thermal value of a anomaly compo.desc: This action enables a uav to analyze the thermal value of a component. If the value is equal to or above the maximum threshold, the component is marked as an anomaly. After the analysis, the uav becomes available again.
Analyse thermal value of a anomaly compo.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to analyze [value1] of [object1]. If [value1] is above or equal to [value2], the uav can mark [object1] as [state1], and the uav becomes [state2].
